notes.title: Free Major Update coming June 7th!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

It’s been 4 months since our last update but we’ve been cooking because Pyrene is about to extend its territory… 

Ever heard of French Brittany? Bretons? You’ll find out about its myths and legends through the new major update on [b]June 7th[/b]!

[previewyoutube=5rMymjyCKX0;full][/previewyoutube]

And, we’ll have a 24hr-Daily Deal on June 7th, the discount will last 7 days so hopefully more players can pick up Pyrene and try it out. Tell your friends about the upcoming discount!

Without further ado, here is what you can expect from the update:

[b][i]Note: the update picks up after the base game story![/i][/b]

[h1]Update Content[/h1]

[h3]4 New biomes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Whispering Woods - So eerie, it might even bring monsters back to life.
[*] Wild Moor - A place that will keep you stuck in its pouring rain.
[*] Granite Shore - Wade across the tide, but beware of the electric eels.
[*] Twilight Field - Only the bold and the well-prepared will survive this endless night. [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/ec99c03a1db1274b5c3ecb1c6e936687c98e5d47.png[/img]

[h3]5 New Playable Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Malo the Mana User - A young sorcerer wielding a mana-powered hand of cards.
[*] Dahud the Shapeshifter - A legendary druid channeling the power of her animal forms.
[*] Margot the Bone Doctor - An imperious fairy using bones to heal and to hit. [/list]
… and 2 other secret ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/d4388e54ed754ffcdd913d4857067a51634b8c89.png[/img]

[h3]5 New NPCs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yuna
[*] Keridwen
[*] Merzhin
[*] Safir [/list]
… and a last one, that you’ll unlock under certain conditions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/ae22aef9e94610849e26116af1783e0d1a654052.png[/img]

[h3]New Elements[/h3]
[*] 50+ New Equipment Cards
[*] 50+ New relics
[*] 20+ New merciless monsters!

And 2 new Herensuge challenges for each playable character!

[h1]Chinese localization[/h1]
We’ve been seeing an uptick of Chinese players in our wishlists and sales so Pyrene is now localized in this language (Chinese Simplified)!

[h1]Pyrene Mobile Incoming[/h1]
That’s not all! With the success of Forward on mobile, we figured we would continue learning about this market by releasing a mobile version. Hopefully this version brings you just the right amount of bite-sized fun! We’re curious to know how much you would be willing to pay for a mobile version?



[b]Oh, and, we might have one more surprise for you in the next couple of months… what could it possibly be?[/b]



Let us know what you think about this update in the comments or on [url=https://discord.gg/W75XqwF7BG]Discord[/url]! And please help spread the word on social media or by telling a friend! ❤️

notes.title: v1.11 | Hard Mode is LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The [b]Hard mode[/b] update is now available! We'd be happy to know what you think about it, let us know on [url=https://discord.com/invite/npEp7VHmQ4]Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/1e5288ddad4b425ddba47624ee47ef759577b434.png[/img]

[h3]Update features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Select up to 10 corrupted relics to spice up your runs
[*] A gauge for each character that displays your best ongoing score
[*] A new passive effect "Provocation" added to some enemies
[*] 2 new achievements to unlock once you reach the final level of the Hard Mode
[list][*] [b]High Five[/b]: Bring 5 characters to level 10 of the Watchtower Hard Mode
[*] [b]Keepers of the Watchtower[/b]: Bring 11 characters to level 10 of the Watchtower Hard Mode. [/list]
[*] 2 new Herensuge challenges for Idittu
[*] New danger zones with distinct card disposals
[*] 15 new relics
[*] Accessibility: Weather visual effects toggle[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/c3d95dd989cd953cdffb9a6b1538d32afe67d72f.png[/img]
[i]“High Five” & “Keepers of the Watchtower” achievement icons[/i]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list][*] Pagomari gives 2 Lucks instead of 3
[*] "Heart of Mountain" enemies got their HP reduced
[*] Some relics and cards rarity got adjusted
[*] "Blue Cristal" and "Pink Cristal" cards' effect is applied every 3 turns
[*] After finishing the story, 2 biome cards are still offered at the end of the Votive Altar [/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the endless HP increase of Gashia even after turning into a bear.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented from quitting or trying again an ongoing run.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented from moving on cards generated by a power.
[*] Fixed a bug that generated a partial corruption of the save file.
[*] Typo fixes.
[/list]

[h3]That's not all.

[b]BIG NEWS will come out this Summer.[/b] Stay tuned because we’re sure you’ll love it. Care to guess what it could be? 👀[/h3]

Thank you for your unfailing support, see you in June!

The Two Tiny Dice team

notes.title: v1.11 | Hard Mode incoming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Get ready - minmaxing has never been more essential.

- The Two Tiny Dice team

notes.title: 1.03 Update | Fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're back with a little patch that addresses the following:


[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug preventing you from leaving an expedition under certain conditions (which caused the game to softlock).
[*] Fixed a bug with Torque and Divine Fruit cards that generated an infinite Echo loop.
[*] Cards no longer overlap when generating cards in the biome first zone.
[*] The 5th biome selected in level 3 of the workshop is no longer ignored.
[*] Isop no longer appears in the steles zone when no longer required.
[*] Corrected spelling errors
[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Powers that open an interface now interact with “Sigil” relics.
[*] Increased health for the last boss in the game's story.
[*] Some watchtower relics only appear once the associated feature (such as luck) has been unlocked.
[*] A new relic has been added to the watchtower, in late game, allowing you to reroll with gold instead of wood.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.02 Update | Small fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're back with a little patch that addresses the following:

[u][b]BUG FIXES AND BALANCING[/b][/u]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] It is no longer mandatory to collect all the cards in the zone to change biome when the main story is over.
[*] Chest opening animation has been greatly optimized.
[*] More Steam achievements are checked when loading the save game.
[*] Cards given by Andos now display a description with the correct value.
[*] The “Corrupted Wood” card has been removed from the list of cards in the warehouse collection.
[*] Free mode allows you to launch an expedition with the selected character.
[*] Gashia's bear form can no longer increase the rage bar.
[*] Millaris no longer increases Gashia's HP.
[*] Text corrections
[/list]

[b]Cards[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Pure Water Potion” card no longer triggers powers that open an interface.
[*] The “Blue Crystal” card can now receive echo.
[*] The “Divine Fruit” card can now receive echo.
[*] The “Cervoise” card no longer crashes when there are no cards to duplicate.
[/list]

[b]Relics[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Golden Chalice” relic now gives +2 to loot cards rather than +3.
[*] The “Red Helmet” relic now gives shield when the enemy takes bleeding damage rather than when it receives the status.
[*] The “Silver Chalice” relic no longer gives shield with the “Iron Bracelet” relic.
[*] The “Broken Chalice” relic no longer prevents you from obtaining a “Votive Altar” card in the Mairu Totem zone.
[*] The “Ethereal Feather” relic no longer reduces the dodge value of the “Ethereal Knife” card by -2.
[*] The “Burning Tooth” relic can no longer be duplicated.
[/list]

[b]Powers[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Perfect Copy” power increases its cost by +1 spirit after each use.
[*] The “Telekinesis” power increases its cost by +1 spirit after each use.
[*] The “Illumination” power increases its cost by +1 spirit after each use (instead of +2 previously).
[*] The “Lyre” power cost increased from 8 to 12 spirits.
[*] The “Shield Conversion” power generates cards on which you can move.
[*] The “Spark” power generates cards on which you can move.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.01 is LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you very much for the feedback provided on the testing branch!

Here's a list of all the changes made so far:

[b]=============================[/b]

[h3]Characters[/h3]

[b]Mathilda:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mathilda now has a “Basic Shield" stat that can be increased thanks to Holy Plant cards.
[*] Her HP increase from 4 to 5.
[*] Her deck starts with a “Golden Apple” card.
[*] Her default power is now “Sliding”.
[/list]

[b]Gashia:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gashia has a new “Spiritual Plant” relic that reduces the cost of her powers by -1 spirit per Holy Plant collected.
[*] Her HP increases from 10 to 12.
[*] Her “Bear Statuette” card now triggers the burn status of enemies in play. Its value drops from 5 to 3.
[*] The default spirit cost of her powers is higher.
[*] The “Simple Ring” card in her deck has been replaced by a “Fire Staff” card.
[/list]

[b]Tanegui:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tanegui has a new “Sparkling Stones” power that generates gold coin cards.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Global:[/b]
[list]
[*] Chests require higher values for epic and legendary items (the best possible chest remains at 18).
[*] Bosses have more HP.
[*] Addition of a “Dead Luck” relic in the watchtower, which disables the chance stat.
[*] The gold price of anvils has been slightly increased.
[*] Relics sold by Hadetta (“Sigil” relics) are more expensive.
[*] Tantugou now sells unique and high-powered relics.
[/list]

[b]Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Whetstone” card now gives +1 to N cards in play permanently (rather than +N to 1 card). It has been upgraded from rare to epic.
[*] The “Ring of Ekhi” card conditions the generation of a Holy card to a number of HP.
[*] The “Invisibility Potion” card still gives the same amount of dodge, but then reduces HP to 1.
[*] The “Blue Crystal” card now deals 1 damage without the possibility of being upgraded.
[*] The “Ethereal Shield” card has been upgraded from legendary to epic.
[*] The “Thorny Plant” card has been upgraded from common to rare.
[*] The "Scales” card upgraded from common to rare.
[*] The "Invisibility Cloak” card value was reduced from 3 to 2.
[*] The “Red Cloak” card changes from a value of 2 to 1.
[/list]

[b]Relics:[/b]
[list]
[*] The 4 “Sigil” relics that inflict status when using a power now target a single enemy rather than all of them.
[*] The “Sigil of Protection” relic only triggers with powers costing 3 spirits or more.
[*] The “Sigil of Agility” relic now gives 2 dodges instead of 3.
[*] The “Enhancement Ring” relic is now unlocked by visiting 11 biomes (rather than by obtaining 6 steles).
[*] The “Precious Skull” relic no longer causes enemies to attack if they have died in the meantime.
[*] The “Sigil of Improvement” relic now confers a +1 rather than a +3 bonus.
[*] The “Ether Sigil” relic no longer triggers powers that open an interface. It has been upgraded from rare to legendary.
[*] The “Monster Meat”, “Monster Eyes” and “Red Helmet” relics now give 1 resource.
[*] The “Fire Stone” relic now deals 4 damage instead of 8.
[*] The “Scale Belt” relic upgraded from rare to epic.
[*] The “Feather” relic upgraded from common to rare.
[*] The “Iron Belt” relic upgraded from epic to legendary.
[*] The “Gold Belt” relic upgraded from common to rare.
[*] The “Elixir of Dodge” relic upgraded from epic to legendary.
[*] The “Garnet” relic upgraded from common to rare.
[*] The “Amethyst Belt” relic was downgraded from legendary to epic.
[*] The “Belt of Strength” relic was downgraded from legendary to epic.
[*] The “Invisibility Hood” relic was downgraded from epic to rare.
[*] The “Book of Demons” relic was downgraded from rare to common.
[*] The “Pine cone” relic was downgraded from legendary to rare.
[/list]

[b]Special powers:[/b]
[list]
[*] The dark forest power “Follow the Light” no longer triggers relic effects.
[*] The “Telekinesis” power can no longer target spirit cards.
[*] The “Rapid Attack” power can no longer be triggered automatically when dodging (this could generate an infinite loop).
[*] The “Stealth” power is now free, even under the “Curse” weather effect.
[*] The “Lenient Winds” power cost increased from 1 to 3 spirits.
[*] The “Lyre” power cost increased from 5 to 8 spirits.
[/list]

[b]Talismans:[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Talisman of Potion” no longer targets Zoè.
[*] The “Talisman of Metamorphosis” no longer invokes Zoè.
[*] The “Talisman of Wealth” now works as it should.
[/list]

[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] The board reroll button is now positioned on the right of the screen.
[*] The 5th power is now correctly positioned after the others.
[*] It is now possible to leave an expedition from a chest.
[*] Unlocking the sanctuary now selects the correct number of powers.
[*] The Anvil can no longer be closed by mistake during hammer animation.
[*] Power costs are now correctly displayed on the character screen.
[*] It is no longer possible to submit the Pagomari screen several times.
[*] A text appears on the main screen indicating to click to continue.
[*] Various spelling and localization corrections.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Steam achievement “All for One” can now be completed.
[*] The Steam achievement “Herensuge Challenges” can now be completed.
[*] The Steam achievement “Andos Legacy” now requires 5 items instead of 9.
[*] Dodge is correctly consumed with every attack.
[*] Holy cards are now generated correctly with Mathilda and Gashia.
[*] Akohan and Tanegui can select an additional power in the sanctuary.
[*] The “Windy Meadow” biome no longer triggers its wind effect when its weather effect has been removed with a card.
[/list]

[h3]We hope you enjoy these new adjustments! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/npEp7VHmQ4]Discord[/url] and [b]say what you think about the game by leaving a review[/b]![/h3]

The Two Tiny Dice team

notes.title: 1.01 - Ready to test!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First off: We cannot stress how happy we are with the launch of Pyrene! Thank you for welcoming the game with such enthusiasm and leaving your reviews!

We've tweaked and fixed some bugs you pointed out in the bug report forum on Discord, social media and reviews. Thank you for that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/63eec36ed99d918ec2e58bbd191429577554ab48.png[/img]

Some of these reports suggested balancing issues that we have since reworked.
[b]To us, one of the fun parts of Pyrene is that you can "break the game" by being extra greedy and accumulating a ridiculous amount of modifiers through the cards, relics and more. We still want this to be possible but now it'll be more difficult to achieve![/b]

That being said:
[h3][quote=author][b]You can now play 1.01 in the "Testing" branch of Steam![/b]

The testing branch is kind of like a test server where you can play a version of the game that includes fixes and tweaks before being officially patched and sent out to everyone. The preliminary changelog is in Discord but we'll post an official Steam news update to annonce the patch + post the entire changelog tomorrow or Wednesday.

If you want to see the changelog ahead of time. please feel free to [url=https://discord.com/invite/npEp7VHmQ4]join our Discord[/url] and share your thoughts so we're sure everything works fine and we can make it go live asap![/quote][/h3]

[h3]How to access the BETA?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Go to your library
[*] Right-click on the Pyrene app
[*] Select "Properties"
[*] Then go to the "Betas" section
[*] Select "testing - Branch made for testing new changes" and close the window to launch the update.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/12b8d9082c9c11e608b5f2165b4d17ce516edffc.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Team Interviews - Game Design & Dev with Christophe!
notes.content:
Meet the people who have brought Pyrene to life in these short interviews!

Finally, let’s meet Christophe, head of Two Tiny Dice, who has operated Pyrene’s development. 

[h3]Are you satisfied with the balance between all the game's mechanics?[/h3]

Yes!

I'm happy about the deckbuilding mechanics that create a path through the zones. This is a refreshing feature that works very well in my opinion. Combined with the greedy aspect of the Votive Altars that increase in value, it creates a good balance between risk and reward.

I like easy-access games, with few actions possible at the same time. For a while, I was scared that deck management, relics, powers and talismans would be too difficult to handle and make the game stodgy.

I've worked hard to ensure that these systems are easy to learn and non-invasive to the game's basic gameplay. You only have to deal with one thing at a time. For example, talismans are only managed when facing an Erge Altar. So, it's a game mechanic you don't need to think about the rest of the time. The same goes for relics in chests.

The number of choices at any given moment is always limited. [b]But the total number of choices throughout a whole game is considerable[/b]. That's what makes the game so interesting and replayable, in my opinion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/a68efa3adb3f52f78e852827559dbb545e9b0020.gif[/img]

[h3]Pyrene is similar to your previous game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1766390/FORWARD_Escape_the_Fold__Ultimate_Edition/]Forward: Escape the Fold[/url], yet so different. Which elements make them stand out from each other?[/h3]

I'd say that Pyrene takes Forward's basic features but pushes them further while adding new ones, such as:
[list]
[*] A deck of cards to manage and improve
[*] More possibilities for movement and cards on the board
[*] Varied situations thanks to different biomes, weather effects, boss mechanics, etc.
[*] Meta-progression with a village to rebuild and upgrade to unlock content
[*] A "Luck" and "Affinities" system to guide the building of your deck
[*] Wider range of status effects with greater synergies
[*] Narration and the NPCs you meet
[*] Other secrets to discover 👀
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/c967d9f8c0a836f84b9230dea5a0d82610128175.gif[/img]

[h3]How convenient is working with your own game engine? Did you find it smoother to work with the rest of the team?[/h3]

It's very convenient to work with my own engine. What I particularly appreciate is working on interfaces, and traditional engines make this part very unsatisfactory in my opinion. With my own engine, I'm not afraid to add tooltips, tutorials, UI opening/closing animations, etc.

This has also allowed us to be quite free in combining tools used outside the engine. For the narration, for example, Marion could use the writing tool that suited her best, and I developed a system to import that into the game automatically. 

I think our work process is reliable from that point of view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/139b89174dedc3bde6ea0ad50bac18b59514d279.png[/img]

[h3]What makes you proud about Pyrene? What is the most important thing you've learned from the development?[/h3]

What makes me proud? The innovative side of the game.

When we think of a roguelike deckbuilding game, we immediately think of [i]Slay the Spire[/i] or any other game with a side view and a hand of cards at the bottom of the screen. Pyrene is a far cry from that, which was our intention from the start. I'm happy to have succeeded in keeping to this line throughout development. As for the gameplay, the concept I created 2 years ago is actually pretty close to the final game.

The most important thing I've learned? To work in a team—and ours worked out pretty well, which is amazing—and not to go into the red by working too much—that's the deal with this kind of job. That's two things, oops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/86214ee906f4002a6e8d1887c571e59a0acc24ae.gif[/img]

[h3]Pyrene will launch on September 13th, be ready to spread the word on our socials! [b]Feel free to wishlist the game[/b] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3WxJ5BtHJ9]Discord[/url] to share your excitement with us![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468100/Pyrene/

notes.title: July Devlog #2 | 3 mythical figures you’ll meet in Pyrene
notes.content:
As you know, Pyrene is deeply inspired by the myths from the Basque Country and the Pyrenees.

We thought you might be interested in a little spotlight on some of them and tell you about their background!

[h2]1. Jentil/Jentilak[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/15d5093fce21f233c005d0404f312474fef133cb.png[/img]

Living in the mountains, these furry giants lived before the Christian era. The legends say they represented the Basque people. They were known to throw rocks at their enemies, but they’re above all protectors of the mountains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/9cedc9c6ee64f0468953026733f1a883dc2be86c.gif[/img]

Also… [b]They have a sort of alter ego: the Basandere/Basajaun![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/133e7c83ca06141b856b2984b1ea72e31dd8d0ac.png[/img]

Basandere is feminine, Basajaun, masculine.

They protect their forest, are more isolated. They are basically humans who were living a primitive lifestyle. They didn’t live in the same era as the Jentilak but are similar physically and in their role in the legends.

In Pyrene, we have decided to represent them more creature-ish, like corrupted Jentilak. You’ll fight these pitiless creatures in the danger zones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/628a20719bbb8cd780fdddee75222967dc91ed16.gif[/img]

[h2]2. Millaris[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/216f386b11b81d248a194086d144e7abde5e412b.png[/img]

You can’t miss him out with his adorable boy, a Great Pyrenees!

Millaris is an old shepherd known to have provided the snow all across the Pyrenees! As it snowed for the first time, he knew he had the duty to spread it across the mountains. A duty he passed on to his sons, and it has snowed every year in this mountain range ever since.

You’ll meet Millaris as a merchant in Pyrene!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/f12bcc887a58f6d73755071956da41e8a0d7fa9a.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Mamarro[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/ff5ba494a0fafebb96d03fa8166e29aac3a2f4ca.png[/img]

Unlike the giant beings mentioned previously, Mamarroak are small protectors from the Basque land! It was said that you could summon these winged insects with a needle box, and they’d do anything to lighten your daily life.

Thanks to Mamarro, you can duplicate your relics in Pyrene!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387931/4a250d3e3c20ac91b833aeb9fc7be39cd628a4fd.gif[/img]

[b]What else would you like to know about Pyrene? Feel free to tell us in the comments!

Our [url=https://discord.gg/3WxJ5BtHJ9]Discord server[/url] also has a smoother setup to collect feedback and bugs, feel free to join it![/b]

notes.title: Pyrene will be out in September!
notes.content:
[h3]Upgrade your deck, slay mythical creatures and find that Votive Altar - [b]Pyrene will release in September 2024[/b]![/h3]

As we share this exciting news with you, we also wanted to let you know that [b]we updated the demo[/b] ahead of Steam Next Fest. Here's what's changed:

[list]
[*] New weather effects
[*] New exploration points to unlock more zones
[*] New bosses with unique mechanics
[*] Simplified the watchtower. It's now an easy/accessible mode.
[*] Merchants are much cheaper
[*] Chests provide rarer content than before
[*] Rebalanced all the enemies in all the biomes (quantity, HP and passive effects).
[*] Added the possibility of seeing the details of the dungeon deck.
[*] Added the anvil to improve your cards
[*] Erge Altar (talismans) now uses gold instead of spirits (to not be "afraid" to use your powers).
[*] Added Pagomari to improve one affinity
[*] Added Andos, which gives us special (and very powerful) cards.
[*] Added a bunch of new relics, cards and talismans
[*] The village buildings are functional
[*] Added new comeback mechanics
[/list]

Don't forget to [b]wishlist the game[/b] to not miss out on its release and join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/Hc3rWyhu3b]Discord[/url] and let us know your favorite part of the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468100/Pyrene/

notes.title: First Update - Demo changelog, Feedback and Upcoming events!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Just wanted to provide a first update with Pyrene.

Firstly, we're super excited to see the positive reception to the demo! It's a good validation that we're on the right track so thank you for that. Before we get into the feedback, here is a list of changes to the demo that we pushed on Monday:

[h1][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/h1]

[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Enemies now drop a votive shard when the votive altar is in play. This is the new way to increase the altar.
[*]10+ new layouts for danger zones.
[*]After the first victory, you can now start a run by choosing the starting biome.
[*]A relic now indicates the number of cards left to draw to find the votive altar. It will be available at the start of the game, in the watchtower.
[*]You can now switch between Zoè and Akohan simply by clicking on the card.
[/list]

[u][b]Balancing[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Frost, bleed and dodge statuses now decrease by 1 after each move.
[*]Some cards had their effects changed because they were either too powerful or useless (including honey, divine fruit, iron ingot, fire flower, ethereal shield, healing herb...)
[*]Fixed many bugs and balancing issues that made the game too easy to "break".
[/list]

[u][b]UI / UX[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]For greater clarity, in danger zones, empty spaces are marked as inaccessible.
[*]The "spend the night" button is displayed in red when you take damage. And a skull when it's lethal.
[*]To better identify them, cards from our deck are now marked with a small flag below their value.
[*]It's now possible to hold down the click to add wood to a building.
[*]Managing save slots is easier.
[/list]


[h1][b]FEEDBACK[/b][/h1]

As mentioned before, we're incredibly happy with the inital reception and overall positive reviews that came from the demo. Although it's a good first validation, we know there's room to improve.

In order for us to build a better game, It's important to better understand [u]why[/u] you liked it or didn't like it. That being said, we made an [b]anonymous[/b] feedback form with some questions to know more about your experience. No question is mandatory but the more information you can give us, the more we can improve!

[url=https://forms.gle/5YzfiLnTdvAKQeQMA]Here is the link to the feedback form[/url]


[h1]UPCOMING EVENTS[/h1]

We can finally announce that we'll be in the #TurnBasedThursday fest next week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7EozKii.png[/img]

We're hoping this can generate more eyes on our project and we're actively looking at other showcases to participate in to branch out.

We've applied to a bunch but this is the only one that is confirmed as of right now. We'll keep you all up to date whenever we are chosen for other showcases.

[h1]THANKS![/h1]

That's all for now! We're still hard at work on the game but we're keeping in touch with our community on social media, Steam and Discord. If you haven't done it yet, [url=https://discord.gg/dTvbnXdBBz]Join our Discord[/url]! We share announcements first on Discord and we love talking to you all whether it's to talk about the Pyrene/Forward, game development or games in general so if you have any questions, you know where to find us!

Thanks for your time and have a great day,
Two Tiny Dice
